description: F3 long: the poison letter is read at 41 and never mentioned again; the break is at 51.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: In the back room of the Gilded Stag, Orin unfolds a letter and reads it by lamplight.

transcript.speaker: Orin
transcript.text: Orin reads the letter twice: the duke's envoy will be poisoned at the feast tomorrow night. He burns the letter in the lamp and tells no one.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Ash drifts to the floor. Orin pockets the lamp's brass cap out of habit.

transcript.speaker: Selene
transcript.text: Selene bursts in, flushed from the stairs. "The envoy wants you at his table tomorrow. Isn't that wonderful?"

transcript.speaker: Orin
transcript.text: "Wonderful," Orin says, and smiles too quickly.

transcript.speaker: Selene
transcript.text: Selene chatters about the seating plan, the musicians, the roast swan.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Downstairs a fiddler tunes up; laughter rolls through the common room.

transcript.speaker: Selene
transcript.text: "I'll sit beside the envoy myself and taste every course," Selene says brightly. "Nothing can go wrong."

transcript.speaker: Orin
transcript.text: Orin only nods and pours two cups of wine.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The bells ring midnight over the town.

transcript.speaker: Selene
transcript.text: Selene yawns and heads for the door. "Sleep, Orin. Tomorrow is a happy day."

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Orin sits alone in the dark room long after she leaves.
